THE SPARK
BEHIND IT ALL
TechSpark — Where Curiosity
Finds a Platform, Innovation
Finds Its Spark.
TechSpark is more than a technical club —
As the official technical club of the Department of Computer Science and
Engineering at DSATM, TechSpark brings together students who are
passionate about technology, creativity, problem-solving, and innovation.
Originally known as AlgoSphere, the club was reimagined as TechSpark with a
renewed vision of creatinga stronger culture of building, experimenting,
collaborating, and learning beyond the classroom.
Through technical events, competitions, innovation-driven activities,
collaborative experiences, and platforms such as Aurora Tech Fest, TechSpark
aims to create an environment where students don't simply learn
technology — they experience it, build with it, and grow through it.
The previous fest script describes this ecosystem simply and powerfully:
“TechSpark ignites ideas."
